user.title: Connect to Boiler Room Agent
user.description:
First, install the agent on your SteamOS device by running this command via SSH or Konsole:

curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rappo/boiler-room/main/install.sh | bash

Once the agent is running, enter the device IP below.

init.title: Boiler Room Settings
init.description: Configure optional integrations for your SteamOS device.

data_description.jellyfin_api_key: Generate in Jellyfin Dashboard → API Keys
data_description.jellyfin_app_id: Default: org.jellyfin.JellyfinDesktop. Use your preferred Flatpak client.
data_description.youtube_app_id: To find the ID, SSH into your SteamOS device and run: flatpak list --columns=name,application | grep -i tube. Leave empty to use the system browser.
data_description.cache_artists: Cache artist names from your Jellyfin library so voice commands can match unusual spellings (e.g. deadmau5, Gorillaz)
data_description.cache_albums: Cache album names for the same phonetic voice matching
data_description.cache_interval: How often to refresh the cache with new library items, in minutes. Default 30. Range: 5–1440 (24h).
data_description.app_aliases: Map friendly voice names to Flatpak IDs. One per line or comma-separated. Example: youtube=rocks.shy.VacuumTube, browser=org.mozilla.firefox. Find IDs by running flatpak list on the device.

error.jellyfin_auth_failed: Jellyfin authentication failed. Check your API key.
